verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents building voice agents that handle live session audio, with turn detection and interruption handling, and LiveKit Inference runs supported AI models inside LiveKit Cloud. Together these imply that live audio reaches model endpoints during a session, but no item explicitly describes streaming session audio to a transcription (STT) or realtime model endpoint. Egress only covers recording and RTMP export, not model endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of piping live room audio to STT or realtime model endpoints, a named list of supported transcription or realtime providers, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, live session audio can be streamed to a transcription or realtime model endpoint while the session is running

citations.quote: Build a simple voice agent with Python or Node.js in less than 10 minutes.
Automatic turn detection and interruption handling
LiveKit Inference lets you run supported AI models directly within the LiveKit Cloud environment without requiring API keys.
